hook: Open with the single most striking motion shot or landmark reveal in the first 1-3 seconds, with a centered white sans-serif text overlay in the upper third (place name or short title).
structure: 3-5 highlight moments, mixing wide and close-up

pacing.pace_notes: Fast, rhythmic, hard cuts. Allow the closing shot to run longer (2-3 seconds).

visual_treatment.text_style: Centered white sans-serif text overlay in the upper third

audio.narration: optional: one short line over the opening and one over the closing

prefer: mix of wide and close-up shots
avoid: any single clip longer than 3 seconds

confidence: Derived from 3 reels (2 full-length, 1 teaser). Length and narration were set manually. Tune after testing.
